title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Mobile Unit 8 conducts training during Northern Challenge 2026
description: U.S. Navy explosive ordnance disposal technicians assigned to EOD Mobile Unit 8 conduct improvised explosive device drills during Northern Challenge 2026 at Keflavik Air Base, Iceland. Northern Challenge is an annual exercise hosted by the Icelandic Coast Guard that advances interoperability across 17 nations and fosters mutual commitment to regional stability. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Nicholas Carter)
pass_reason: IED drill, mostly kneeling prep; small debris burst at the end; EOD already covered today (-16)
